ValidationRule.description: BRD Contact Cadence: Next Contact Due date must be set when contact not established and attempts remain. Ensures visibility for agents.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Contact_Established__c <> TRUE, NOT(ISBLANK(Contact_Attempt_Count__c)), Contact_Attempt_Count__c < 5, ISBLANK(Next_Contact_Due__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Next Contact Due date is required when contact is not established and attempts remain. Please set the next scheduled contact date per BRD cadence (Day 5, 35, 65, or 95).
